```{r setup, include=FALSE}
### Import the data from Excel ###
library(readxl)

data1 <- read_excel("/Users/erinanderson/Desktop/R_Work/Stats_Project/BLE_CoreProgram_EnvironmentalData.xlsx", sheet = "WaterData")

### Get rid of columns I don't need ###
library(dplyr)
data1 <- data1 %>% select(-TOSS_mg_L, -TDN_umoles_L, -POC_d13C, -POC_uM, -PN_d15N, -PN_uM, -depth_m, -TSS_mg_L, -abs_co_250.x, -abs_co_254.x, -abs_co_350.x, -abs_co_400.x, -abs_co_412.x, -abs_co_440.x, -spec_slope_275_295, -SUVA254, -pycnocline_depth_m, -DOC_umoles_L, -POM_CNratio, -H2O_d18O, -ammonia_umol_N_L, -cond_us_cm, -DO_mg_L, -sp_cond_us_cm )


### Select only for the open water season to avoid confounding variables ###
data1 <- data1 %>% filter(season != "break up")
data1 <- data1 %>% filter(season != "under ice")

### Remove the few rows that do not have useful data ####
data1 <- data1 %>% filter(lagoon != "not applicable")

### Code the numeric variables as numbers ###
data1$chl_a_ug_L <- as.numeric(data1$chl_a_ug_L)
data1$pH <- as.numeric(data1$pH)
data1$DO_percent <- as.numeric(data1$DO_percent)
data1$temp_C <- as.numeric(data1$temp_C)
data1$sal <- as.numeric(data1$sal)
data1$phosphate_umol_P_L <-as.numeric(data1$phosphate_umol_P_L)
data1$silicate_umol_SiO2_L <- as.numeric(data1$silicate_umol_SiO2_L)
data1$nitrate_nitrite_umol_N_L <- as.numeric(data1$nitrate_nitrite_umol_N_L)

### Remove NA values ###
data1 <- na.omit(data1)

### Check how many rows are left ###
nrow(data1) #120
```
